mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% occurs in more than 20% of days, but 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals persistent labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.5% occurs in more than 10% of days, but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 235 indicates stagflation risk, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 235) occurs in more than 5% of days, but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 900 and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100), overvaluation and impending policy tightening suppress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 917 in February 2013, INDPRO at 99.04 in February 2013
failure_condition: The condition (HOUST > 900 AND INDPRO > 100) occurs in more than 10% of days, but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production (INDPRO) level indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 95 occurs in more than 20% of days, but 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it signals an overheating economy that prompts Federal Reserve policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 235 occurs in more than 10% of days, but 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 135000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 900 indicates strong labor market and housing recovery that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS at 135689 in March 2013, HOUST at 962 in February 2013
failure_condition: The condition (PAYEMS > 135000 AND HOUST > 900) occurs in more than 5% of days, but 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of those days.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts (HOUST) level indicates strong residential demand that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 900 occurs in more than 20% of days, but 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 50% of those days.
